definitions.gloss: overall length; total length; full length
definitions.explanation: The complete length of something measured from one end to the other.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{橋|はし}→橋：02163_hashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{全長|ぜんちょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧500⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧だ。
examples.english: The total length of this bridge is about 500 meters.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{蛇|へび}→蛇：02246_hebi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{全長|ぜんちょう}3⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: This snake reaches an overall length of 3 meters.

examples.japanese: {全長|ぜんちょう}100⟦キロメートル→キロメートル：02873_kiromeetoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}→高速道路：09242_kousokudouro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦{開通|かいつう}→開通：04122_kaitsuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: A highway with a total length of 100 kilometers is scheduled to open next year.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧ (all, complete) and {長|ちょう} (length). Used for measuring the full extent of physical objects such as vehicles, bridges, tunnels, rivers, and animals. Commonly appears in specifications, descriptions, and technical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全長|ぜんちょう}〜⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧: ~ meters in total length
- {全長|ぜんちょう}〜⟦キロ→キロ：01350_kiro⟧: ~ kilometers long
- {全長|ぜんちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧〜: approximately ~ in total length
- ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{全長|ぜんちょう}: the overall length of a car

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {全幅|ぜんぷく}: overall width — the width counterpart to {全長|ぜんちょう}
- {全高|ぜんこう}: overall height — the height counterpart
- ⟦{長|なが}さ→長さ：05326_nagasa⟧: length — the general, everyday word for length
